## [1.3.0](https://github.com/rikunode/pupil-swipe-disable-patches/compare/v1.2.0...v1.3.0) (2026-10-15)

### ✨ New Features

* add optional Favorites random shortcut for Pupil 6.1.1 ([0971581](https://github.com/rikunode/pupil-swipe-disable-patches/commit/0971581223dc71a372dda7e7e0bfcf26fd1013ad))

patches.name: Disable automatic update checks
patches.description: Stop Pupil 6.1.1 checking for updates at startup and showing update prompts. Manual update checking in Settings remains available.

patches.name: Disable gallery left swipe
patches.description: Disable the left-swipe action tray on Pupil 6.1.1 gallery cards. Preserve taps, long taps, reader gestures and vertical scrolling.

patches.name: Favorites random shortcut
patches.description: Show a one-tap random gallery button above the bottom navigation on the Favorites tab in Pupil 6.1.1.
